question: For what purpose was the gaṇa or Gaṇeśa served by her?
premises: Service was performed by a female agent.
The purpose was the slaying of Durga.
The gaṇa, identified as Gaṇeśa, was the object of service.
inference: She served the gaṇa, Gaṇeśa, for the purpose of slaying Durga.
uncertainties: The bracketed token [gaṇeśaḥ] is an editorial addition clarifying gaṇaḥ.
plain_english: By whom the gaṇa, Gaṇeśa, was served for the purpose of slaying Durga.
